method: Eleuthera, Harbour Island and Spanish Wells: the Devil's Backbone and north coast, Current Cut, Harbour Island's Atlantic reefs, and the south-west wall off Cape Eleuthera. No official site list exists: the Bahamas National Trust protects no Eleuthera dive sites by name. Lists used: the tourism list (Bahamas Ministry of Tourism dive page together with the My Out Islands Eleuthera and Harbour Island diving pages, counted as one list); Valentine's Dive Center, Harbour Island (its own per-site pages, read through the Wayback Machine 2016 snapshot because the current site names no sites); Ocean Fox, Harbour Island (Romora Bay; names Devil's Backbone, Current Cut and Cistern Rock); Ocean Fox Cotton Bay at Cape Eleuthera (its dive-sites page, a separate operator under different ownership); and the Aqua Cat and Aggressor liveaboard site lists for south-west Eleuthera (Aqua Cat, Blackbeard's and Cat Ppalu count as one owner). The Dive Shop at Cape Eleuthera Resort and Spanish Wells operators publish no site names; blogs and lodging guides were read for leads only. A site counts when named, recreationally divable on scuba and on at least two of those lists. Cistern Rock is excluded as a 3 to 8 foot snorkel and bubblemaker site. Counted 2026-10-14.
